start.title: [TODO:pt-BR] The Parable
start.text:
[TODO:pt-BR] Jesus turns to you.
"A man entrusted his wealth to his servants."

choices.feedback: [TODO:pt-BR] Stay. This story is for you.

leave_consequence.title: [TODO:pt-BR] Come Back
leave_consequence.text:
[TODO:pt-BR] Every gift in your hand waits.
Return and hear.

giving.title: [TODO:pt-BR] The Master Gives
giving.text:
[TODO:pt-BR] He hands out talents:
five, two, and one, each by ability.

choices.text: [TODO:pt-BR] Receive what is given to you

resent_consequence.title: [TODO:pt-BR] Yours Is Enough
resent_consequence.text:
[TODO:pt-BR] Envy buries every talent.
Receive what is yours.

choices.text: [TODO:pt-BR] Receive what is given to you

five.title: [TODO:pt-BR] Five Talents
five.text:
[TODO:pt-BR] The first servant lifts five bags.
"I will go and trade at once."

mock_consequence.title: [TODO:pt-BR] He Walks in Faith
mock_consequence.text:
[TODO:pt-BR] He trusts what was placed in him.
Learn from his step.

two.title: [TODO:pt-BR] Two Talents
two.text:
[TODO:pt-BR] The second weighs two coins.
He sets out quietly to work.

choices.text: [TODO:pt-BR] Tell him to wait for more

wait_consequence.title: [TODO:pt-BR] Begin Today
wait_consequence.text:
[TODO:pt-BR] Tomorrow has its own seeds.
Use what is in your hand.

one.title: [TODO:pt-BR] One Talent
one.text:
[TODO:pt-BR] The third digs a hole at dusk.
He buries his single coin in fear.

choices.text: [TODO:pt-BR] Hide your own gift as well
[TODO:pt-BR] Beg him to use it instead

fear_consequence.title: [TODO:pt-BR] Fear Is Not Faith
fear_consequence.text:
[TODO:pt-BR] Caution that buries is not wise.
It is faithless.

choices.text: [TODO:pt-BR] Beg him to use it instead

hide_consequence.title: [TODO:pt-BR] Lift It Out
hide_consequence.text:
[TODO:pt-BR] No gift was meant for the dark.
Dig it up again.

choices.text: [TODO:pt-BR] Beg him to use it instead

return.title: [TODO:pt-BR] The Master Returns
return.text:
[TODO:pt-BR] After a long time he comes back.
"Show me what you have done."

excuse_consequence.title: [TODO:pt-BR] Own Your Work
excuse_consequence.text:
[TODO:pt-BR] Each life answers for itself.
Speak for what is yours.

reward_five.title: [TODO:pt-BR] Well Done
reward_five.text:
[TODO:pt-BR] The first brings ten talents.
"Well done, good and faithful servant."

choices.feedback: [TODO:pt-BR] His joy can be yours too.

envy_consequence.title: [TODO:pt-BR] Run Your Race
envy_consequence.text:
[TODO:pt-BR] Faithfulness, not size, is praised.
You will be measured the same.

reward_two.title: [TODO:pt-BR] Equal Praise
reward_two.text:
[TODO:pt-BR] The second brings four talents.
"Well done. Enter into joy."

small_consequence.title: [TODO:pt-BR] All of It Matters
small_consequence.text:
[TODO:pt-BR] Two talents earned the same words.
Nothing given is too small.

judgment_one.title: [TODO:pt-BR] I Was Afraid
judgment_one.text:
[TODO:pt-BR] The third holds out a dirty coin.
"I was afraid. I hid it away."

choices.feedback: [TODO:pt-BR] Fear was never his master's wish.
[TODO:pt-BR] Tears rise for the buried gift.

defend_consequence.title: [TODO:pt-BR] Fear Is Not Humility
defend_consequence.text:
[TODO:pt-BR] True humility uses the gift.
It does not hide.

ending.title: [TODO:pt-BR] Use What You Hold
ending.text:
[TODO:pt-BR] Jesus looks at you and says,
"To everyone given much, much is asked."
